categories.description: Small things to try between classes.

posts.title: Breathing into your back
posts.excerpt: Pilates breath goes sideways and back, not up into the shoulders. Here is how to feel it.
posts.content:
Sit tall and wrap your hands around your lower ribs. Breathe in through the nose and let the ribs widen into your hands.

Breathe out through the mouth for twice as long, and feel the ribs knit back together. Ten breaths, every morning.

posts.title: Five minutes for a stiff spine
posts.excerpt: A short evening routine on the floor: rolling down, bridging up, and one long twist.
posts.content:
Lie on your back with knees bent. Peel the spine up into a bridge one bone at a time, then lay it back down the same way.

Five slow bridges, then let both knees fall to one side and breathe there for a minute. Swap sides.

posts.title: A new after-baby class
posts.excerpt: From 4 November, a small Tuesday morning class for new mothers. Babies are welcome on the mat beside you.
posts.content:
The class starts gently with breath and the deep belly muscles, and builds over eight weeks.

Four places only. Please wait at least eight weeks after the birth, and ask your doctor first.
